description.value: The Waddling Dog is an award-winning neighbourhood pub attached to the Quality Inn Waddling Dog hotel in Saanichton, serving classic pub dishes with a west coast twist alongside a full bar. An onsite beer, wine, and spirits shop rounds out the offering, making it a convenient stop near the BC Ferries Swartz Bay terminal and Butchart Gardens. It sits just off Highway 17 (Patricia Bay Hwy), a key artery for cyclists on the Saanich Peninsula.
